__meta__.description: IQ-9075 (Hexagon v73 HTP) CALIBRATED QNN-INT8 column for the three-platform vision corpus. Companion to backend's vision_corpus_three_platform.json.
__meta__.caveat: LATENCY-VALID, ACCURACY-N/A. INT8 quantized with RANDOM calibration data (qai_hub submit_quantize_job, INT8 w+a). Quant params do NOT change timing so these latencies are representative real-INT8-kernel numbers; but the model outputs are meaningless (no real calibration). Do NOT read any accuracy/quality from this column. Same principle as the eIQ-Neutron r3 latency finding.
__meta__.toolchain: Qualcomm AI Hub: submit_quantize_job(INT8 w+a, random calib) -> compile qnn_context_binary -> profile on-device
__meta__.finding: INT8 pays on the bandwidth-bound HTP (1.4-3.4x) where the launch-bound 5090 batch-1 gets 0.7-1.2x (nothing/slower). clip_vit (low-res, no bandwidth pressure) the control: ~1.07x iq9 ~= 1.09x 5090. Confirms INT8 is a bandwidth format. BONUS: QNN INT8-built yolo11s-seg + yoloe which TRT's INT8 (Myelin bug) could not.
